# upstreamyard/conductor

> Multi-arch (amd64, arm64), cosign-signed container image for Conductor OSS, the open-source workflow orchestration engine originally built at Netflix, with server and UI in one image. Community-maintained by upstreamyard; not an official Conductor image. Pull `upstreamyard/conductor:<version>` or `ghcr.io/upstreamyard/conductor:<version>`. API on port 8080, UI on port 5000. Runs without dependencies on SQLite; for production use PostgreSQL.

Key facts: health `GET /health` (process only), metrics `GET /actuator/prometheus`, Swagger at `/swagger-ui/index.html`, non-root UID 10001, only stable releases (no `-rc` tags). Configure with Spring env vars (`CONDUCTOR_DB_TYPE=postgres`, `SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://...`) or a properties file in `/app/config` selected by `CONFIG_PROP`; the file overrides env vars, and a missing file stops the container with an error. No authentication. Run a single replica (default lock is `local_only`).
